1.
Development Code Amendment No. 256 – Updated Telecommunications Facilities Regulations– The City of Azusa Planning Commission will consider making a recommendation to the City Council regarding a proposed ordinance related to Telecommunications Facilities.  Chapter 88.46 (Telecommunication Facilities) was last substantively amended in 2010. Since then, changes in federal and state law—including various court decisions and Federal Communications Commission (FCC) orders and regulations—have placed significant procedural and substantive limits on the City’s exercise of local control over matters involving wireless communications facilities. This proposed ordinance (“Ordinance”) would amend Chapter 88 to comply with these changes in the law by repealing and replacing Ch. 88.46 and amending the definitions in Ch. 88.70. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to Section 15061(b)(3).
2.
Development Code Amendment No. 260 – 2025 Code Amendment Series 1 – The City of Azusa Planning Commission will consider making a recommendation to the City Council regarding proposed amendments to the following chapters of the development code as part of a series of amendments considered to be clean up items: Chapters 88.24.005 (Allowed Uses in Districts), 88.30.070 (Trash Enclosure), 88.36.100 (Driveways and Site Access), 88.42.170 (Solid Waste/Recyclable Materials Storage), 88.28.030 (Special Purpose Zone Land Uses and Permit Requirements), and 88.70.020 (Definitions of Specialized Terms and Phrases) of the City of Azusa Development Code. The proposed changes include removing the allowance of Small Collection Recycling Facilities in the Edgewood District (DE), establishing objective standards for trash enclosures, modifying allowable land uses in the REC zone, updating residential driveway requirements, and adding new definitions to the Development Code. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to Section 15061(b)(3).
